about_the_game:
A grieving girl. A broken world. A path soaked in blood and memory.

Ashen Daughter is a hand-drawn Metroidvania set in a crumbling world where the old gods have fallen silent. Play as Kára, a young woman resurrected by the Whisperer. Driven by vengeance but shadowed by grief, she must face corrupted emissaries, buried memories, and the sins of her own family.

Explore ruined villages, enchanted forests, and lightless caverns. Unlock powerful abilities, uncover the fate of your people, and decide whether forgiveness is possible in a world built on sacrifice.

Whether you're a seasoned Metroidvania player or simply drawn to a beautifully told story you can explore at your own pace, Ashen Daughter offers a deeply emotional journey with fluid controls, meaningful choices, and a world worth getting lost in.

Key Features

* Responsive and satisfying movement & combat

* Hand-drawn 2D world inspired by Norse folklore

* Blood Bargains: Sacrifice your health for powerful, lasting upgrades to fuel your fury

* Emotional story of vengeance, grief, and forgiveness

* A challenging yet approachable Metroidvania experience

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Linux (e.g. Ubuntu 22.04+, SteamOS 3.0+, Manjaro)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti (2 GB VRAM) or Mesa-compatible AMD GPU
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: OpenGL/Vulkan required. Some window managers may cause issues—tested on GNOME
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Linux (e.g. Ubuntu 22.04+, SteamOS 3.0+, Manjaro)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 / RTX 2060
  • Storage: 9 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Dedicated GPU and SSD recommended for smooth performance.
